info.description:
This is API for Data Collaboration Application.

# Authentication

API Key is used which is a secure credential that is tied to user account. This key should be included in the header of the request for example as below:

x-api-key:D99213612XXXXXXXXXXXF4ABD62D2

# Assumption

This API is intended and should be called by server-side application instead of user client directly. For security, It will result in Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) errors if using in a client-side application.

# API Endpoints

The base URL under different environments as below:

#### _UAT_

[https://dtc-api.lfuat.net/api](https://dtc-sit.lfuat.net/api)

#### _PRD_

[https://dtc-api.lfapps.net/api](https://dtc-sit.lfuat.net/api)

request.description:
_Create a request record_

- mandatory checking for requestReference, requestDescription, documentIdand workspaceId
    
- validation of documentId and workspaceId
    
- user authorization checking of workspaceId

_Share a request to a user by user email address_

- validation (duplication, existence) of {userEmail}
    
- user authorization checking of request

- message (optional): customized text in email content

- sendEmail (optional): email sending (Y / N), default is Y if not specified

_Share a request to a user by user id_

- validation (duplication, id existence) of {userId}
    
- user authorization checking of request
    
- message (optional): customized text in email content
    
- sendEmail (optional): email sending (Y / N), default is Y if not specified

_Share a request to a user group by user group name_

- validation (duplication, existence) of {userGroupName}
    
- user authorization checking of request
    
- message (optional): customized text in email content
    
- sendEmail (optional): email sending (Y / N), default is Y if not specified

Share a request to a user group by user group id

- validation (duplication,  id existence) of {userGroupId}

- user authorization checking of request

- message (optional): customized text in email content

- sendEmail (optional): email sending (Y / N), default is Y if not specified

_Copy a request and sheet data_

- copySheet: “Y“ - include sheet data

- check id existence of {requestId} and {requestIdToBeGrouped} from collection Requests
    
- {requestIdToBeGrouped} cannot be existed in collection RequestGroups
    
- user authorization

Get a single request record by {requestId}

- exact match
    
- return error if more than one record returned
    
- return active record only

get a single request record by request ref. under workspace

- exact match

- return error if more than one record returned

- return active record only

_Search and list request record(s) with criteria_

- workspaceName - workspace
    
- pending : (Y/N) - filter with pending records only
    
- request : (Y/N) - filter with request records only
    
- filters - filtering criteria - AND followings:
    
    - requestReference- Request Reference

    - requestDescription - Request Description

    - documentName - Document Name

    - collectionName - Collection Name

    - ownerEmail - Owner’s email address

    - assigneeEmail- Assignee’s email address

    - requestStatusName - Request’s status

    - requestIsActive - Request Active or not (return all records if not specified)
_List shared users of a single request record_
_List shared user groups of a single request record_
_List available views of a single request record_
_List grouped requests_

_list amendment logs of a single request record_  
  
viewId - (mandatory except workspace admin) filter fields under the specified view  
logDatStart - (optional) filter logs from this date (ISO 8601, UTC)  
logDatEnd - (optional) filter logs up to this date (ISO 8601, UTC)  
logByEmail - (optional) filter by the user who made changes (exact match)

_Update a request record_

- mandatory checking for requestReference and requestDescription
    
- validation of collectionId (id existence if any)

_Update status by status name_

- validation of requestId and statusName
    
- return error if more than one Status ID found
    
- user authorization

_Update status by status ID_

- validation of {requestId} and {statusId}
    
- user authorization

- ccEmailToAssigner (optional): cc email to Assginer (follow user preference by default)

_Update assignee by email address_

- validation of {requestId} and {userEmail}
    
- user authorization

- ccEmailToAssigner (optional): cc email to Assginer (follow user preference by default)

_Update assignee by User ID_

- validation of {requestId} and {userId}
    
- user authorization
    
- ccEmailToAssigner (optional): cc email to Assginer (follow user preference by default)
_Un-share request of a user group by user group name_
_Un-share request of a user group by user group ID_
- check id existence of {requestId} and{requestIdToBeUngrouped} from collection RequestGroups

request.description:
_Create a request record and a sheet record_

- Workspace Name, View Name and Document Name will be used in JSON
    
- View validation - column exists, mandatory, readOnly
    
- Check user have view permission
    
- Request will be shared to requestAssigneeEmail as well
    
- requestAssigneeSharingViewNames is list of views access for the shared user requestAssigneeEmail
    
- view control validation (i.e. field mandatory and editable)

_Add image to a sheet_

Parameters:

rowindex - Row index in the sheet

columnname - Column name in the sheet

- mandatory checking for rowindex and columnname
    
- validation of rowindex and columnname
    
- upload image to Azure blob storage and update collection Sheets
    
- view control validation (i.e. field editable)

_Add attachment to a sheet

Max file size: 50Mb

Parameters:

- rowindex - Row index in the sheet
    
- columnname - Column name in the sheet
    
- mandatory checking for rowindex and columnname
    
- validation of rowindex and columnname
    
- system will upload attachment to Azure blob storage and update collection Sheets
    
- view control validation (i.e. field editable)
    
- supported file extension: PDF, JPG, JPEG, GIF, TIF, TIFF, XLS, XLSX, DOC, DOCX, TXT, MSG, ZIP

_Get a single sheet record_

filters:

- retrieve a subset of data based on specified criteria
    
- AND will be used between the field
    
- Date format will follow the user preference
    

operator

- Equality: (case-insensitive) = (equal to), != (not equal to)
    
- Comparison: (case-sensitive) > (greater than), < (less than), >= (greater than or equal to), <= (less than or equal to)
    
- Containment: (case-insensitive) \~ (contains), !\~ (does not contain), in (included in an array), not in (not included in an array)
    

Available operators for field type:

- Text: equality, comparison, containment
    
- Number: equality, comparison, containment
    
- Date: equality, comparison, containment(in, not in)
    
- Checkbox: (YES, NO, Empty String) equality, containment(in, not in)
    
- Dropdown list: equality, comparison (compare by string only), containment
    
- Dynamic Dropdown: equality, comparison (compare by string only), containment
    
- Multiple Dropdown list: containment(in, not in)
    
- URL: equality, comparison, containment
    
- LOOKUP: equality, comparison, containment
    
- Attachment: (meta data) equality, comparison, containment
    
- Image: (meta data) equality, comparison, containment

_Partial_ _update of sheet record_

- view control validation (i.e. field editable)

_Update the sheet and replace all the data_

- view control validation (i.e. field editable)

- the view must include all fields of corresponding document
